code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(range(10), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        rs=[y for y,x in cells]; cs=[x for y,x in cells]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        rh,rw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if rh>=3 and rw>=3 and len(cells)==2*rh+2*rw-4:
          fill=2 if (rh-2)%2==0 and (rw-2)%2==0 else 7
          for y in range(r0+1,r1):
            for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); print(p)
